ui.rules_commands_help:
COMMANDS (Options to select or uncheck):
  w<num>     : Toggle/uncheck rule in Workspace (e.g. w1, w2)
  g<num>     : Toggle/uncheck rule in Global (e.g. g1, g2)
  <num>      : Toggle rule in Workspace (shortcut: 1, 2)
  all-w      : Select all in Workspace
  all-g      : Select all in Global
  clean-w    : Desmarcar all from Workspace (remove from project)
  clean-g    : Desmarcar all from Global (remove from machine)
  clean-all  : Desmarcar all (remove from Workspace and Global)
  s / save   : Save and apply changes
  v / back   : Return to main menu
